correctness.rationale: The proof classifies every possible cyclically complete factor: the nondecreasing predecessor-gap inequality forces all cyclic zero gaps to be equal; the rotation with \(r\) full zero runs yields the exact necessary plateau length; a plateau of \(r\) gaps supplies all rotations. Zero-only and one-marker classes occur because gaps are unbounded. The distinct classes give the exact divisor formula for every \(n\ge1\). Direct length-bounded checks of 8,788 cases agree with the theorem but are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Determines a natural symmetry-sensitive invariant of an infinite nonuniform family from the complete multiplicity profile, including skipped gaps and arbitrary finite plateau lengths. It exposes a sharp structural transition: strictly increasing gaps yield constant Lie complexity \(2\), while \(m_a=a\) gives an explicit, elementary, sparse word with unbounded Lie complexity and quantitative factorial subsequence lower bounds. The precise classification, not the previously known possibility of unbounded Lie complexity, supplies its mathematical contribution.
